Lord's Mark Industries Reports Significant Profit Growth in H1 FY27

Lord's Mark Industries announced its financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2027 (H1 FY27), reporting a profit of ₹82 Crore. This figure is 1.7 times the company's entire profit for fiscal year 2026 (FY26). The company also reported a 47% increase in its second-quarter profit (Q2) compared to the first quarter (Q1) of FY27. Future plans include launches in the US and UK in 2027, alongside advancements in AI Dialysis and Cancer Screening technologies.
